messages.content: Refund rule: refund 50% when the model call takes more than two minutes and produces fewer than 200 output tokens. Engineering note: this is equivalent to latency_ms > 120000, but support agents will say 'over 2 minutes'. Full refund still requires provider_error=true and a valid request_id.
Half refund for over two minutes and <200 output tokens; full refund for provider_error with request_id.
